description: Add ECS-based concurrency detection so scheduled tasks can skip execution when a previous run is still in progress, preventing overlapping ingestion runs
steps: Create src/prediction_data/core/ecs_guard.py with async function should_skip_concurrent(command_filter: str) -> bool
Read ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 env var (set by Fargate automatically); if absent (local dev), return False immediately
GET {metadata_uri}/task to retrieve own TaskARN, Cluster ARN, and Family from the ECS task metadata endpoint
Call ecs.list_tasks(cluster=cluster, family=family, desiredStatus='RUNNING') via boto3 to list sibling tasks
Filter out own task ARN from the list of running tasks
Call ecs.describe_tasks() on remaining task ARNs and inspect overrides.containerOverrides[].command for the command_filter string
Return True (skip) if any other running task's command contains the filter string; False otherwise
Handle errors gracefully: if metadata endpoint or ECS API fails, log warning and return False (proceed rather than block)
Add unit tests in tests/test_ecs_guard.py: not-in-ECS returns False, no other tasks returns False, matching concurrent task returns True, non-matching tasks returns False, API error returns False

description: Add --skip-if-concurrent flag to the backfill catchup CLI command that invokes the ECS concurrency guard before running
steps: Add --skip-if-concurrent typer.Option(False) boolean flag to the backfill_catchup command in cli/main.py
When flag is set, call should_skip_concurrent() with the entity name(s) being processed before entering the main loop
If should_skip_concurrent returns True, log 'SKIP: concurrent task detected for {entity}, exiting' and return exit code 0 (clean exit)
When flag is not set (default), skip the check entirely — existing local-dev behavior is unchanged
Add unit tests: catchup with --skip-if-concurrent when guard returns True exits cleanly with SKIP message, when guard returns False proceeds normally

description: Replace the polymarket-trades EventBridge schedule with polymarket-order-filled running the catchup command with concurrency guard
steps: In infrastructure/eventbridge-schedules.yaml: rename PolymarketTradesSchedule resource to PolymarketOrderFilledSchedule
Update schedule Name to polymarket-order-filled-${Environment}
Update Description to 'Catchup Polymarket order_filled events every 5 minutes'
Change the command override to: ["backfill", "catchup", "--platform", "polymarket", "--entity", "order_filled", "--skip-if-concurrent"]
Keep rate(5 minutes) schedule expression and existing retry policy (MaximumRetryAttempts: 2, MaximumEventAgeInSeconds: 300)
Rename TradesScheduleExpression parameter to OrderFilledScheduleExpression (update all references including KalshiTradesSchedule which also uses this parameter)
Update infrastructure/ecs-cluster.yaml: change ExampleRunCommand output to use backfill catchup order_filled example instead of ingest polymarket-trades

description: Grant the ECS task role permissions to introspect running tasks for the concurrency guard
steps: In infrastructure/iam-ecs-roles.yaml: add a new policy statement to ECSTaskRole for ECS task introspection
Grant ecs:ListTasks and ecs:DescribeTasks actions
Scope the resource to the ECS cluster ARN (requires adding ECSClusterArn as a parameter or using a wildcard scoped to the account/region)
Verify the policy doesn't grant broader ECS permissions than needed (no RunTask, StopTask, etc.)

description: Update CloudWatch metric filters, alarms, and dashboard to monitor polymarket-order-filled instead of polymarket-trades
steps: In infrastructure/cloudwatch-monitoring.yaml: rename PolymarketTradesMetricFilter to PolymarketOrderFilledMetricFilter
Update the FilterPattern to match order_filled catchup log output (e.g. '"order_filled" "polymarket"')
Update MetricName to PolymarketOrderFilledRuns
Rename MissingPolymarketTradesAlarm to MissingPolymarketOrderFilledAlarm with updated AlarmName, AlarmDescription, and MetricName reference
Rename TradesExpectedIntervalSeconds parameter to OrderFilledExpectedIntervalSeconds (update all references)
Update the dashboard widget: change 'Polymarket Trades' label to 'Polymarket Order Filled' and reference the new metric name
Update the alarm ARN in the dashboard alarm widget from missing-polymarket-trades to missing-polymarket-order-filled
Update Outputs section: rename MissingPolymarketTradesAlarmArn to MissingPolymarketOrderFilledAlarmArn with updated references

description: Update the release 01 check script and verify end-to-end that the new schedule works correctly
steps: In scripts/check_setup_release_01.py: update expected schedule name from 'polymarket-trades-prod' to 'polymarket-order-filled-prod'
Verify the check script still expects 6 total schedules (the count doesn't change, just the name)
Run pytest -m 'not integration' — all tests pass
Run mypy src/ — type check clean
Run ruff check src/ tests/ — no new lint issues
Verify dry-run works locally: prediction-data backfill catchup --platform polymarket --entity order_filled --dry-run
After deploying updated CloudFormation stacks, run python scripts/check_setup_release_01.py and verify all checks pass
